title: Compositions of etale morphisms are etale
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)

difficulty_reason: The lemma records that a composition of etale morphisms is etale. The proof uses that etaleness is a local property of ring maps, which was observed in the proof of the characterisation lemma, and then quotes the general permanence result for a property of ring maps together with the algebraic statement that etale ring maps are stable under composition.
